subject: Original-client movement around Luna Cavern sandbags to mission 1994 cave trigger

setup.client: Recovered original compatibility client 1.16.5.0 under Wine/Xvfb and isolated bubblewrap network
setup.world: Copy of deployed world with six courtyard Thrax 198660-198665 and three camp companions 198688-198690; no staged courtyard Warrior. Ordinary enemy attacks remained enabled. Live databases and containers were not altered.
setup.character: Copied level-2 Alden started at previously native-client-reached upper checkpoint (316.13,120.28,85.93), yaw 0.859892129898071, mission 1994 objective 2 active. The checkpoint bypasses continuous camp travel and is an emulator route diagnostic.
setup.navmesh: Original client boot-camp navmesh adv_bootcamp.nav SHA-256 10a6fd9a1fa9ef88d89befe9b757cacdefb6584cc584ce2462393178f85b2f52; NavProbe from the prior sandbag position (309.24,120,78.68) to the cave center (279.05,120.5,66.07) returned a complete route through (308.40,121.11,80.00), (295.60,120.11,77.20), (293.60,120.31,76.40), (292.40,120.31,75.20), (287.60,120.71,69.60). This is map path evidence, not proof that final-live players followed those exact points.

trials.inputs: After playable HUD: H, W 1200 ms, A 400 ms, W 1000 ms, then W+A 2000 ms, W 2000 ms, W 1500 ms.
trials.result: The initial movement reached (309.4,119.9,78.5). W+A and following W did not advance past the barrier; area 198602 stayed 32.8 m away. The client screenshot shows the recruit at the sandbags. This disproved the initial directional assumption for that camera angle.

trials.inputs: From a fresh copied checkpoint after playable HUD: H, W 1200 ms, A 400 ms, W 1000 ms, then W+D 2000 ms, W 2000 ms, W 1500 ms. No GM teleport or attack suppression occurred after login. Script run-sandbag-route-controlled-11-20260924.py SHA-256 3d7c60cdd19b755314965f2cb5dc3300a082c7a95e5f31e24d302b015512452b.
trials.result: The native-client movement left the blocked sandbag point, passed (301.9,119.8,81.3), (297.7,120.0,77.7), (292.1,120.0,74.3), (289.0,120.5,71.6), and reached (284.6,120.5,67.8). The first area 198602 entered-true probe occurred at 21:27:11.112 local, 5.8 m from its center. The original client displayed Objective Completed: Capture the Flag / Find a way out of the cave and advanced the tracker to the boss. The copied char.db has mission 1994 objectives 4=2, 2=2 and 1=1; SQLite integrity_check returned ok. The final screenshot still showed Alden standing while taking visible -11 to -15 hits. No Thrax died or player reward was recorded in this brief route probe.

assessment: This verifies that the deployed-derived binary and recovered client can route around the sandbags and advance mission 1994's cave objective under the current six-Thrax attack setup. It does not establish the final-live route, encounter spawn sequence, survival over a full fight, or boss completion. The path can now be combined with adaptive target acquisition in a continuous camp-to-cave replay.
